title: Show HN: Agent Package Manager (APM) for Agent Configuration
description: Microsoft/GitHub open-sources a package manager for AI agents (Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor) that handles dependency management, version pinning (apm.lock), and security auditing (apm audit). Signals that organizations are moving toward formalizing and locking down agent configurations.

title: Show HN: G0 – The control layer for AI agents (scan, test, monitor, comply)
description: A control layer that provides behavioral monitoring, red teaming, and a kill switch for AI agents in production. Integrates with CI gates to block merges of insecure agent configurations.

title: Show HN: Vett – Scan, sign, and verify AI agent skills before installing
description: Registry for scanning and signing AI agent 'skills' (SKILL.md). Reports critical risks like obfuscated exfiltration scripts being called in agents like Claude Code and Codex.

title: I got tired of Claude Code/AI agents messing up my codebase, so I built Node9
description: An open-source 'Sudo' wrapper for agents (Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Cursor) that enforces policies: allows safe commands but intercepts risky ones (force push, dangerous bash) for manual Slack approval.

title: Show HN: DevOpsAgents – AI agents to deploy and manage your infra
description: AI agents purpose-built to deploy and manage production infra (K8s, AWS, etc.) while retaining infrastructure-specific context across sessions.
